results.title: Real One
results.overview: A young man must escape a family party with a gun in his waist in order to get revenge on those who jumped him.

results.title: Confini, canti
results.overview: For decades, Transalpina Square in Gorizia marked the dividing line between two different Nations and cultures. Alongside this segment of the Italy-Slovenia border, tragic events took place, though dreams and hopes persevered. It is thanks to those hopes and dreams that the separating wall was eventually torn down and the border was finally crossed.

results.title: Sorry For Not Saying I Love You
results.original_title: Desculpa Não Dizer Que Te Amo
results.overview: Rosa and Maria are mother and daughter who have a troubled relationship. Despite not showing affection, Rosa makes courageous decisions to ensure that her daughter, Maria, follows a different path from her own in all areas of life. The movie takes us on an exploration of the lives of two generations of black women from the same family, revealing a plot of love, conflicts and mutual understanding.

results.title: To a Land Unknown
results.overview: Cousins Chatila and Reda are saving to pay for fake passports to get out of Athens. When Reda loses their hard-earned cash to his drug addiction, Chatila hatches an extreme plan to pose as smugglers in an attempt to get them out of their desperate situation before it is too late.

results.title: Reversion
results.overview: Mario sees his brother David's kidnapping. When David returns 19 days later with no memory, Mario suspects the returnee isn't really his brother. His investigation challenges his grip on reality.

results.title: Delicious
results.overview: During their vacation in the French countryside, a wealthy German family becomes entangled with a young hotel worker harboring sinister intentions.

results.title: Logout
results.overview: Pratyush, a social media influencer who is about to reach his biggest milestone in terms of followers to land a deal with a brand, loses his phone to a fan obsessed with him. Trapped in his own house without his phone, Pratyush must find a way to reclaim his identity and his career.

results.title: αLPα
results.overview: After his arrest, Banyu, a punk vocalist, is sent to a moral rehabilitation center—where he meets Deri, the ghost of his past and the town’s respected cleric. Between rebellion and remorse, Banyu fights against the system that confines him, only to realize his only path to freedom lies within the last person on earth he wants to see.

results.title: Blood Weekend
results.overview: Witness the debut of a brand-new crazed masked killer, The Necrobutcher! Ingrid & her gal pals hike into the woods for a rustic bachelorette party at an isolated farm. Meanwhile, Professor Michelle Pleasant has let the crazed killer The Necrobutcher escape and must team up with psychic detective Graveyard John to track down this psycho. Blood and guts fly in Blood Weekend!

results.title: Walter Ninja
results.overview: Walter is convinced he’s a ninja, dedicating his days to training and meditating on the arts of Ninjutsu. His brother Nacho, who financially supports them both, grows increasingly frustrated with Walter’s obsession and urges him to get a "real" job. Tension builds between the two when Nacho confesses he feels ashamed of Walter’s behavior.

results.title: Mara
results.overview: After being released from a psychiatric institution, a troubled young man battles terrifying visions of a mysterious woman from his past while trying to reintegrate into society. As his reality unravels, he must confront the sinister force manipulating his mind before he loses himself completely.

results.title: Empareja2
results.overview: Emparejados is a comedy-acting show starring José Ordóñez Jr. In it, the 10-time world record holder in joke telling, confesses on stage with a lot of humor and sensitivity how he went from hunger to fame, making his wife his main victim.

results.title: Six Candies
results.overview: A playful self-help book promising guilt-free pleasure circulates among a group of gay men, setting off a series of sexy and comedic encounters. A couple, eager to renew their spark, embraces the book’s hedonistic rules for a year of indulgence. Two executives working on a shared project discover an attraction that quickly blurs professional lines. Meanwhile, a model and a photographer explore new desires during a photo shoot that becomes more intimate than expected. As their paths cross, the men learn that chasing pleasure can lead to chaos, laughter, and unexpected freedom.

results.title: The Badgers
results.overview: When Berny (11) joins a motley Scouting troop called the Badgers, he resolves to win the Golden Scout Trophy, which his deceased father had won. However, when Berny’s radicalized foster mother, Gerdy, weasels her way into becoming the Badger's new co-leader, she cancels all future competitions. This year's competition is Berny's only chance at the trophy, so he cheats through the trials to become the Badger’s selected contestant. This sparks rivalry with jr. troop leader, Lars (13), and ignites a battle for the throne between Gerdy and her naive co-leader, Gunnar. Now Gerdy leads a coup d’état and is about to seize the rights to the Scout house. Unless Berny confesses his charade, the Badger’s will lose everything; will he sacrifices winning the trophy and risk losing his newfound friends?

results.title: Amelia Palmer's First Movie
results.overview: An aspiring director takes extreme measures after her first film is canceled.

results.title: Blur
results.overview: Gloria sits quietly at a bus stop at night, waiting. Memories from her youth suddenly flood and take control of her thoughts. A dreamlike, nonlinear narrative unfolds and binds us to “Dre,” a young man experiencing an intense personal crisis. What follows is a brief record of caregiving in the world.

results.title: Aaromaley
results.overview: Ajith, a romantic dreamer faces reality when forced to work at a matchmaking agency under Anjali,a pragmatic, grounded woman, devoid of dreamy illusions. Their conflicting ideologies become the foundation of a relationship that’s as charming as it is unfiltered.

results.title: The Strokes of Mireia
results.overview: When Mireia acknowledges the lack of support from her dad to study art, she will have to decide whether she follows her dad's orders to study medicine, like him, or follow her own desire.

results.title: Wanni Bik
results.overview: Originally from Rabat, Yassine, a young technician, leaves the capital to settle in Laâyoune, the cradle of Sahrawi traditions. Upon his arrival, he meets Olaya, a young Sahrawi Master's student, with whom he falls in love.  The two lovebirds are quickly confronted with harsh reality. They must stand up to Mouloud, Olaya's uncle, who is pulling out all the stops to marry his niece to his son, Salem. The young couple decides to face all obstacles to defend their love, especially in a conservative community that deeply respects local traditions.
